name: Maul of Anarchy
body:
School evocation [chaotic]; Level cleric/oracle 6

DESCRIPTION

As spiritual weapon*, except targets hit are affected as by the chaos hammer spell rather than the normal damage.

Editor’s Note: The actual text refers to the spell spiritual hammer. There is no Paizo spell by this name, but it’s likely that the author intended to reference spiritual weapon.
